messages.text: Which of your 9 and 12 inch globes have metal meridians

The Quincy 9-inch is a desk globe, sized for a tabletop or shelf rather than the floor. As for metal meridians, two of our 12-inch desk globes have them: the Globemaster 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe with Metal Semi-Meridian and the Replogle 12" Blue Ocean Desk Globe with Black Metal Semi-Meridian. Are you drawn to the antique or blue ocean look?

The Globemaster 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe with Metal Semi-Meridian is the one — warm sepia-toned seas with raised relief detail and that metal semi-meridian arc for a classic, studious look, at $88.00. You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
What is the Quincy's meridian made of

I'm not sure of the Quincy's meridian material — it's not listed in what I have on that globe. You can check the full spec on [the Quincy 9-inch page](https://replogleglobes.ca/products/quincy-9-antique-ocean-desk-globe-solid-walnut-base), or email (email hidden) if it's not there.
